code='''def transform(grid):
    row_marks = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if max(row.count(c) for c in set(row)) >= len(row) - 2 and max(set(row), key=row.count) != 0]
    col_marks = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if max(sum(grid[i][j] == c for i in range(len(grid))) for c in {grid[i][j] for i in range(len(grid))}) >= len(grid) - 2 and max({grid[i][j] for i in range(len(grid))}, key=lambda c: sum(grid[i][j] == c for i in range(len(grid)))) != 0]

    def representatives(length, marks):
        result = []
        last = 0
        for mark in marks:
            if mark > last:
                result.append(last)
            result.append(mark)
            last = mark + 1
        if last < length:
            result.append(last)
        return result

    rows = representatives(len(grid), row_marks)
    cols = representatives(len(grid[0]), col_marks)
    return [[grid[i][j] for j in cols] for i in rows]
'''
